Gary is rough and Gary is green, so by the rule “All rough, green people are cold,” we derive: Gary is cold.

Gary is cold, so by the rule “All cold people are nice,” we derive: Gary is nice.

Gary is nice, so by the rule “If someone is nice then they are red,” we derive: Gary is red.

ANSWER: True

Gary cold -> by rule3 Gary nice.
Gary nice -> by rule2 Gary red.
Thus True.
